Configure the translation client

Use the settings page to select a compatible provider and model.

The required name field identifies the skill directory.

A skill is a directory containing, at minimum, a SKILL.md file:

The SKILL.md file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.

Request example

The request is sent only after the user starts translation.

fetch(endpoint, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });

Errors are isolated so the rest of the document remains readable.
